title: Sunday’s practice
intro: Sunday is the Sun’s day: for vitality, purpose and direction. Its practice greets the Sun.

steps.title: Arrive
steps.text: Sit comfortably, with your back upright and soft. Follow the circle: in as it grows, out as it settles. Never strain.

steps.title: Light the lamp
steps.text: Light a real diya if you have one, or this one. Let the flame be the centre of your attention for a moment.

steps.title: The opening prayer
steps.text: Read it once, slowly; the meaning is beneath it.

steps.title: The day’s question
steps.text: Sit with it for a moment. You may write a line, or simply hold it.
steps.prompt: What gives my life direction, and how can I express my strength with humility and purpose?

steps.title: The day’s mantra
steps.text: Repeat it as many times as feels true. One careful repetition is enough; 11, 27 or 108 if you have time.

steps.title: Close
steps.text: Read the closing prayer once, slowly. Then sit for one more breath before you return to your day.

after: Reconnect with purpose. Choose a solar prayer, or a Gita verse on compassion, responsibility or inner direction.
